brief:
Ed Sheeran's ticket prices for his Saturday show in Philadelphia have nearly halved in three days following the removal of rapper Macklemore as the supporting act, Forbes reported. Macklemore was dropped after expressing pro-Palestinian positions, according to Middle East Eye's summary of the Forbes report.

The sharp price drop suggests reduced demand for the concert following the lineup change, though neither the full extent of ticket availability nor Sheeran's or promoters' statements on the matter were detailed in available reporting.

title: Ed Sheeran ticket prices plummet after Macklemore dropped as opener
